title: Google Ad Campaign for Sweet Crumbs Bakery - Enovista Digital Ltd.

facts.fact: Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study lists a target of 50,000 impressions per month for the Google Ad campaign.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study reports the campaign achieved 65,000 impressions per month.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study lists a target click-through rate of 5%.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study reports an achieved click-through rate of 7.2%.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study lists a target cost per click of $0.50.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study reports an achieved cost per click of $0.45.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study lists a target conversion rate of 10%, defined as the share of users who visited the bakery after clicking the ad.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study reports an achieved conversion rate of 12%.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study lists a target cost per acquisition of $5.00.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study reports an achieved cost per acquisition of $4.50.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study lists a target of 5,000 visits per month for total conversions.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery case study reports an achieved total of 7,800 visits per month from the campaign.
The Sweet Crumbs Bakery Google Ad campaign's ad copy offered 20% off the first purchase.
facts.quote: Get 20% off on your first purchase.

facts.fact: Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery campaign targeted users aged 18-45.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery campaign targeted all genders.
Enovista's Sweet Crumbs Bakery campaign targeted users in urban areas within delivery range.
facts.quote: Location: Urban areas within delivery range

facts.fact: Enovista's case study reports the campaign drove 7,800 bakery visits in the first month.
facts.quote: a total of 7,800 bakery visits in the first month
